name: get-things-done
description: Turn fuzzy intent into executable work models with decisions, next actions, and evidence-backed completion. Covers 9 domains including software, product, data/AI, design, operations, and legal.

interface.longDescription: Get Things Done helps ChatGPT and Codex convert incomplete or chaotic intent into an explicit work model: facts, assumptions, decisions, blockers, scope, success criteria, a next executable action, and evidence-backed completion. Works across 9 domain packs: software, product, research, marketing, advisory, data/AI, design/UX, operations, and legal/compliance.
defaultPrompt: Turn this messy idea into an executable work model.
Find what is blocking this work and define the next action.
Check whether this work is actually ready or done.
